newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns A-1-plus to ACE CP programme.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns A-1-plus to ACE CP programme.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Thursday it had assigned its A1-plus rating on the US$2.5 billion ACE Overseas Corp commercial paper programme established by Societe Generale Australia Ltd, a unit of Societe Generale.
"The rating on the programme reflects the unconditional and irrevocable guarantee by ACE Overseas Ltd to the prompt and punctual payment of all notes issued by ACE Overseas Corp," S&P said.
ACE Overseas Corp is wholly-owned by ACE Overseas Ltd and is incorporated in Delaware, U.S. for the sole purpose of issuing and selling debt securiteis as a nominee for ACE Overseas Ltd.
